target_customer: Machine learning and computer vision teams in autonomous driving, robotics and video analytics
problem: Teams can afford to label only a small share of their data and lack a good way to pick which part. Lightly uses self-supervised learning to select the most representative samples.
business_model: B2B software licenses and cloud platform, with open source library and services
product_category: ML data curation and active learning platform

founders.name: Igor Susmelj
prior_employers: Swiss stock exchange (software engineer, two years)
founders.background_notes: From the YC page; published deep learning work at ICML and ECCV.

founders.name: Matthias Heller
education: ETH Zurich and Harvard (described as former students)
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder by Startupticker (May 2022), not on the YC page. Exact degrees not stated.

competitors.name: Voxel51 (FiftyOne)
competitors.what: Open source tool for dataset visualization and selection for computer vision
competitors.traction_then: Named by Lightly as a data curation tool in its 2022 comparison

competitors.name: Aquarium Learning
competitors.what: Data management platform to find mislabeled samples and edge cases

competitors.name: Scale AI
competitors.what: Data labeling provider whose users send data for labeling, with manual data selection
competitors.traction_then: Large labeling vendor; named on the YC page as the labeling example

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires self-supervised representation learning and selection algorithms working at dataset scale; founder had published deep learning research.

defensibility.rationale: Algorithms are research based and widely published; open source library and competing tools exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Labeling platforms added data curation and embedding search over time; no acquisition of Lightly found.

market_need_then: ML teams labeled only about 1 percent of data by cost, and selection was largely manual (YC page, Lightly 2022 blog). Autonomous driving and robotics produced large unlabeled datasets.

identity.logo: Light and dark logo files; design not described
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, short and direct, practical outcomes

branding.brand_signature: Open source library plus a private ML engineering Discord with over 1,200 members (company site)
branding.community_and_virality: About 3.9K GitHub stars and a Discord community of over 1,200 members per the company site.

brand_strength.rationale: Developer community and open source presence help, but the name is an ordinary adverb easily confused with other Light names.

outcome_analysis: Lightly spun out of ETH research, joined YC S21 and raised a 3 million dollar seed in May 2022 led by Wingman Ventures. It has expanded from data selection to a broader Physical AI data platform with open source and community traction, but no later priced round was verified and totals vary between databases.
notes: Seed confirmed by Startupticker and the Nasdaq press release repost plus VentureBeat via search. Lightly's about page claims 10M total funding; CB Insights lists 6.14M over 8 rounds; Caplight lists 4.23M and a grant in 2024. Unverified, no further rounds recorded. Competitor sources are Lightly's own 2022 blog and the YC page, dated within a few months after the batch. Current site shows expansion to a Physical AI platform; date unknown so no pivot recorded.
